# Perfetto C++ Tracing SDK (vendored)

**Source:** https://github.com/google/perfetto, release `v58.2`
**Asset:** `perfetto-cpp-sdk-src.zip`
(https://github.com/google/perfetto/releases/download/v58.2/perfetto-cpp-sdk-src.zip)
**Fetched:** 2026-08-25
**License:** Apache License, Version 2.0 (same as this project — see the
license header at the top of `perfetto.h`/`perfetto.cc`)

`perfetto.h` and `perfetto.cc` are Google's official amalgamated (single
header + single source file) build of the Perfetto C++ Tracing SDK,
generated by their own `gen_amalgamated` tool — not modified here.
Vendored directly (not fetched at build time) so a build of this project
never depends on network access or a pinned-but-external SDK version.

**Why vendored, not built from source or installed as a system package:**
this SDK has no OS package manager presence on a typical dev machine, and
building it from the full Perfetto monorepo requires a much larger toolchain
(GN, Ninja, protobuf codegen) than this project otherwise needs. The
amalgamated release is exactly what Perfetto's own docs recommend for
embedding the SDK in a third-party C++ project.

**Used by:** `src/core/profiling/ternary_profiler.h`'s
`TERNARY_ENABLE_PERFETTO` backend (see that file, and
`src/core/profiling/ternary_profiler_perfetto.cc` for the one translation
unit that must define `PERFETTO_TRACK_EVENT_STATIC_STORAGE()` per the
SDK's own quickstart guide) — see `.claude/CLAUDE.md`'s Critical Gap #10
for the integration's status and validation.

**To update:** download a newer `perfetto-cpp-sdk-src.zip` from
https://github.com/google/perfetto/releases and replace these two files
(same filenames, same license header format); update the version/date
above.
